## Context
The Reconciler Heartbeat Canary detected a persistent bridge outage. Three consecutive scheduled passes fail before config or network because the stdlib-only reconciler runtime imports optional `pydantic` at module scope. A separate preceding REB-3162 visibility failure remains tracked on `dutiable-shaded-honeyeater`.

## Proven root cause
Commit 557f8c16e35 introduced `runtime.py` with `from pydantic import SecretStr`; 40b8ac8295 eagerly loads that runtime from every pass. The bridge installs `.` with no extras, while `pyproject.toml` and `docs/config.md` require the engine/reconciler to remain stdlib-only and place Pydantic only in `[agents]`. Clean-venv, dependency-perturbation, and historical A/B runtime probes confirm this exact activation edge.

## Repair plan
- Replace the Pydantic SecretStr dependency in `runtime.py` with a frozen stdlib credential carrier that preserves the existing observable contract: hidden from repr/equality/hash, exact reveal only at adapter authentication, and accurate presence checks.
- Strengthen the existing clean-runtime subprocess oracle in `tests/unit/test_core_optionality.py` to load the real reconciler runtime while Pydantic is explicitly unavailable, and assert no optional stack is imported.
- Prove the oracle RED before repair, GREEN after a held-out fix, RED again under the exact module-scope Pydantic mutation, then run the reconciler binding suite, lint, typecheck, and the original clean-core reproduction.
- Sweep the reconciler engine for other module-scope imports of optional dependencies; disposition any confirmed sibling.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A subprocess oracle executes the real reconciler runtime with Pydantic unavailable and passes without importing any optional agents dependency.
- [ ] StaticAuth remains immutable, excludes credentials from repr/equality/hash, reveals the exact credential only to the selected adapter, and reports presence accurately.
- [ ] The oracle is observed RED before repair, GREEN after repair, and RED under an exact-defect mutation.
- [ ] The relevant reconciler operation-binding suite, clean-runtime optionality test, lint, and typecheck pass.
- [ ] The original no-extras install/import scenario no longer reproduces, and the sibling sweep is recorded.
